end.parentNote: Asha practised rounding large numbers to the nearest thousand, lakh, and crore, and comparing the original and rounded values. Ayaan used place-value and distance-from-benchmark reasoning in several answers, including comparing 6,30,000 with 6 lakh and 7 lakh. One mix-up was chopping off digits instead of rounding; this was not corrected in a later response. At home, ask Ayaan to round three prices or distances and explain why the chosen place is sensible.
